eps.o: The Voice: Battle of Champions kicks off with powerhouse coaches Adam Levine, Kelly Clarkson and John Legend, who form the only panel in the show’s history comprised entirely of Voice winners. They vie to discover the next singing phenomenon.
Coaches Adam Levine, Kelly Clarkson and John Legend all vie to discover and coach the next singing phenomenon on the second night of blind auditions.
Coaches Adam Levine, Kelly Clarkson and John Legend all vie to discover and coach the next singing phenomenon on the third night of Blind Auditions.
The Battle Rounds begin as the coaches prepare their artists in hopes of reaching the Knockouts. Druski and Reggie Miller track the competition.
The Battle Rounds conclude as the coaches enlist superstar Battle Advisors to help prepare their artists to go head to head in hopes of advancing to the Knockouts.

The Knockout rounds kick off as the coaches pair their artists to perform solo against each other in hopes of advancing to the Semi-Finals. Michael Bublé and CeeLo Green serve as mega mentors. The stakes are high as there are no steals or saves.
The Knockout rounds conclude as the artists perform against each other in pairs in hopes of reaching the Semifinals. Each coach brings back two fan-favorite artists from their past teams.

The final round of the competition kicks off with performances from the top nine artists. For the first time, superfans and past artists will vote for their favorites from the audience, determining who will go to the finale.
A recap of the final round of the competition with performances from the top nine artists.
The top four artists perform a contemporary and classic song to compete for the title of “The Voice.” Superfans and past artists vote for their choice of Season 29 winner from the audience.
